stations.title: Wilf
stations.say: Fix one, and I forget the other

stations.title: Two copies
stations.text: The same state and effect, pasted into both.
stations.note: The sign never lets go of a tram.

captions: Wilf wants the depot screen and the Pithead platform sign to stop being two copies.
Tram 14 leaves the platform sign, comes back, and the sign is following it twice.
You pull the state and the effect into a hook of your own, in four tasks.
Tram 14 is followed once, and when no tram is due the sign lets go of it.
Same tracker, one hook. Every screen that calls it gets its own, the hall board too.
